stage: Task23 originale — prima composizione Ca_HVA + Ca_LVAst
architecture: 2 channels with 2 explicit gates each. Independent: 2 separate 1-w-w-4 MLPs; shared_heads: 1-w-w trunk, 2 heads of width4; conditioned: voltage+2 onehot mechanism ids, 3-w-w-4. SiLU, sigmoid inf, exp(clamped logtau). Initial state and dt only enter analytic convex exponential solver. Analytic gbar*m^2*h*(V-Eca) retained.
fit_sampling: 50% uniform[-135,75],25%[-105,-65],25%[-45,5]; independent 4D initial states, common multiscale dt. Identical tuples/minibatches/mean gate-rate loss per independent seed bundle across families. Independent Adam moments and norm1 clipping per bundle. Shape-compatible weights paired, shapes differ otherwise.
selection: Common width/checkpoint per family over3seeds by worst seed/domain normalized gate/rate/open/current error on development. Freeze all checkpoints and config before fresh/path evaluation. No fresh, OOD, path or held-rollout model selection.
current_semantics: Diagnostic algebra on post-update m/h and supplied evaluation V. No embedded BREAKPOINT timing claim. Nominal gbar1e-5 S/cm2,Eca120mV; fixed 15-case panel gbar multipliers(0,1),(1,0),(.25,4),(1,1),(4,.25) crossed with Eca pairs(120,120),(40,160),(160,40). Current density mA/cm2. Total error normalized per tuple by sum absolute fully-open driving currents; individual by own driving. Zero driving yields zero current error, floor1e-12 protects ratio. Report raw individual and total RMSE too.
path_contract: 5 new imposed paths: constant, steps, ramp, sine, chirp,1000 substeps of.025ms (25ms). Use causal start V for each held substep; future path explicitly supplied experimentally. Paired formula discrete oracle at same dt; not sufficiency at1ms, not autonomous voltage. Long held-V rollout uses repeated1ms steps through10000ms.
promotion: Independent pair must pass all required domains, both mechanisms, all3seeds, currents, held horizons and imposed paths. Sharing confirmed only if that reference passes and a shared family also passes3/3 with fewer selected parameters. Task24 preparation authorized by independent pair pass. Ca_LVA isolated native oracle is mandatory before any training.

hypotheses.calva_oracle: Independent canonical formula matches native Ca_LVAst rates, gate update and current algebra; preserve fixedqt and voltage shift.
hypotheses.composition: Independent learned gates plus analytic current preserve both individual calcium currents and their sum within registered normalized limits.
hypotheses.sharing: At least one shared pair passes every criterion with fewer parameters than independent reference. Task22 sharing failure motivates strict independent control.
hypotheses.identity: Swapping HVA/LVA routing or identity increases median in-support gateRMSE >=10fold acrossseeds; diagnostic, not promotion gate.
hypotheses.scaling: Width32 vs16 and30k vs15k provide paired development contrasts; >=10% score improvement supports corresponding capacity/budget benefit. Never infer universal scaling from one selection.
hypotheses.path_transfer: Frozen candidates stay bounded and accurate on controlled imposed paths and repeated held1ms updates. Autonomous voltage and physiologic embedded transfer remain untested.

limits: First two-calcium-channel composition at imposed V, imposed Eca, explicit m/h. No CaDynamics, endogenous V, synapses, axial coupling, whole-neuron or GPU speedup claim. Widths matched, parameter counts differ; shared output is rate prediction, currents remain analytic. Ca_HVA retrained with new paired data for fair comparison, not silently reusing a legacy decoder.
